subject.title: feat(android): add Wear real-time Talk controls

question: Should OpenClaw permanently bundle Wear real-time Talk and accept the new Wear RPC/event/audio-channel contracts plus the optional talk.session.create language parameter?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and proven, but deciding that these cross-version app and Gateway surfaces become supported product contracts requires Android/Wear and Talk/Gateway owner intent.

options.title: Adopt the integrated contract
options.body: Approve the bundled Wear Talk and additive language surfaces, then land only after a current-main refresh and fully green exact-head gates.

options.title: Split language propagation
options.body: Land the Wear Talk transport separately and defer the cross-platform Gateway/provider language parameter to a narrower follow-up.

options.title: Pause bundled Wear Talk
options.body: Keep the existing one-shot Wear voice flow and close or defer continuous Talk until broader product and compatibility direction is established.

recommendation.title: Adopt the integrated contract
recommendation.body: Approve the bundled Wear Talk and additive language surfaces, then land only after a current-main refresh and fully green exact-head gates.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository explicitly identifies @obviyus as the Android app maintainer, making them the clearest owner for the bundled Wear product decision.
